verdict.rationale: Smooth's docs state that every session has a live view URL for watching the agent in real time, and that you can take over and interact with the browser yourself (smooth-docs-29). The task API also returns a `live_url` for viewing agent actions live (smooth-docs-2). missing for 10: documented handoff semantics (pausing the agent, returning control after takeover, how takeover works when the agent is stuck), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the takeover flow.
